verdict.rationale: Codex generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own data, mainly their code repositories. It explores unfamiliar code and plans changes, runs dedicated reviews that report prioritized findings without modifying the working tree, and returns summaries and diffs. Subagents bring findings back into the session, and plugins connect Codex to team tools and data. Missing for 10: evidence of insights over non-code or business data beyond a brief plugin mention, detail on how suggestions are surfaced for data exploration, and independent hands-on corroboration of review/insight quality.
